label: In the unrestricted higher-order Scott/AFP embedding, an individual satisfies the formal predicate…
meaning: A new structural characterization of Scott/AFP's defined necessary-existence predicate, not an assumed bridge: full higher-order property comprehension admits a bearer-and-world identifying essence. The result separates logical expressibility from metaphysical justification of A5 and identifies a precise dependency on the property domain. Restricted/admissible-property interpretations require separately sourced and formalized variants; do not silently transfer the equivalence to them.
